original_title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 and 2's Leaked PS5 Trophy List Indicates Some Content May Be Missing
summary_en: Trophy lists for the rumored Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 and 2 remasters have surfaced, revealing potential omissions that have fans concerned. Key features like Theater Mode and Wager Matches appear to be absent.
ai_analysis: Leaked trophy data for Black Ops 1 and 2 remasters suggests a curated experience, raising questions about which classic multiplayer modes will truly make the cut for modern consoles.

en.title: Black Ops 1 & 2 PS5 Leaks Hint at Missing Fan-Favorite Modes
en.summary: Trophy lists for the rumored Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 and 2 remasters have surfaced, revealing potential omissions that have fans concerned. Key features like Theater Mode and Wager Matches appear to be absent.
en.body:
The Call of Duty rumor mill is churning once again, this time with whispers of **Black Ops 1** and **Black Ops 2** making a comeback on current-generation consoles. Recent leaks of PlayStation trophy lists for both titles have ignited excitement, but also sparked concern among long-time fans. While many trophies mirror their original PS3 counterparts, the absence of several others points to a potentially trimmed-down experience.

Specifically, trophies related to **Theater Mode**, **League Play**, and **Wager Matches** seem to be missing from the newly surfaced lists. For those who remember the glory days of **Black Ops**, Theater Mode was an invaluable tool for content creators, allowing players to capture and edit gameplay footage. Wager Matches offered a unique, high-stakes twist on multiplayer, introducing fan-favorite modes like Gun Game and One in the Chamber where players bet in-game currency for the chance at victory. The removal of trophies tied to these features strongly suggests they may not be included in the re-released versions, a prospect that has left many players disappointed.

## What's Missing and Why It Matters

The removal of these specific modes isn't just about nostalgia; it impacts the very essence of what made **Black Ops 1** and **Black Ops 2** so enduringly popular. Theater Mode was crucial for the early growth of the Call of Duty YouTube community, enabling a generation of players to share their best moments. Wager Matches, with their inherent risk and reward, added a thrilling layer of unpredictability to the gameplay. While League Play's omission might be more understandable given the difficulty of replicating a robust competitive scene years later, the potential loss of modes like Gun Game and One in the Chamber – even without the gambling element – is a significant blow to the games' replayability.

Fans have taken to social media and forums to voice their frustrations. The consensus is clear: while a remaster is welcome, stripping away beloved features diminishes the authenticity of the experience. The hope is that these modes might still be included, perhaps without associated trophies, or that Activision will reconsider their inclusion before a final release. The developers have a delicate balancing act, aiming to modernize classics while respecting their original appeal.

## What's Next

Details regarding an official release date or confirmation of these remasters have not yet been announced. Players will need to keep a close eye on official Call of Duty channels and reliable gaming news outlets for further updates. The current information, derived from leaked trophy lists, remains speculative until officially confirmed by Activision.

tr.title: Black Ops 1 ve 2 PS5 Sızıntıları Eksik Fan-Favori Modlarına İşaret Ediyor
tr.summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 ve 2'nin yeniden yapılanma sürümlerinin trophy listeleri sızdırıldı ve bazı önemli özelliklerin eksik olabileceği ortaya çıktı. Özellikle Tiyatro Modu ve Wager Matches gibi sevilen modlar listede yer almıyor.
tr.body:
Call of Duty rumor değirmenleri novamente çalışmaya başladı ve bu kez Black Ops 1 ve 2'nin güncel konsollara geri döneceği söylentileri dolaşıyor. Her iki oyunun da PlayStation trophy listelerinin sızdırılması heyecan yaratırken, aynı zamanda uzun süredir oyuna bağlı olanlar arasında endişe yaratıyor. Trophy listelerinde birçok madde orijinal PS3 sürümlerine benzese de, bazılarının eksik olması potentially daha sade bir deneyim sunulabileceğini gösteriyor.

Özellikle **Tiyatro Modu**, **Lig Oyunları** ve **Wager Matches** ile ilgili trophylerin eksik olması, bu özelliklerin yeniden yayınlanan sürümlerde yer almayabileceğini güçlü bir şekilde gösteriyor. Black Ops'un altın günlerini hatırlayanlar için Tiyatro Modu, içerik yaratıcıları için değerli bir araçtı ve oyuncuların gameplay görüntülerini yakalama ve düzenleme olanakları sunuyordu. Wager Matches, **Silah Oyunu** ve **Bir Odada** gibi modları sunarak, oyuncuların oyun içi para ile kazanma şansı için bahis yapmalarını sağlıyordu. Bu özelliklerle ilgili trophylerin eksik olması, bu modların yeniden yayınlanan sürümlerde yer almayabileceği anlamına geliyor ve bu durum birçok oyuncuyu üzdü.

## Bu Neden Önemli

Bu modların eksik olması sadece nostalji değil, Black Ops 1 ve 2'nin neden bu kadar uzun süre popüler olduklarının temelini etkiliyor. Tiyatro Modu, Call of Duty YouTube topluluğunun erken büyümesinde önemli bir rol oynadı ve bir nesil oyuncunun en iyi anlarını paylaşmasına olanak tanıdı. Wager Matches, içkin risk ve ödül ile oyun oynama deneyimine heyecan verici bir katman ekledi. Lig Oyunları'nın eksik olmasının daha anlaşılabilir olabileceği düşünülse de, **Silah Oyunu** ve **Bir Odada** gibi modların kaybetme ihtimali - hatta bahis öğesi olmadan - oyunun tekrar oynanabilirliğini önemli ölçüde etkiliyor.

Oyuncular, sosyal medya ve forumlarda hayal kırıklıklarını dile getiriyorlar. Konsensüs açık: bir yeniden yapılanma hoş karşılanıyor, ancak sevilen özelliklerin kaldırılması deneyimin otantikliğini azaltıyor. Umarız bu modlar hala dahil edilebilir, belki de ilgili trophyler olmadan, veya Activision bunları nihai sürümden önce yeniden düşünür. Geliştiriciler, klasik oyunları modernize ederken orijinal çekiciliğini korumak için nazik bir dengeleme işlemi yapıyorlar.

## Sonraki Adımlar

Resmi yayın tarihi veya bu yeniden yapımların onaylanmasıyla ilgili detaylar henüz açıklanmadı. Oyuncular, resmi Call of Duty kanalları ve güvenilir oyun haber siteleri üzerinden güncellemeleri yakından takip etmek zorunda kalacaklar. Mevcut bilgiler, sızdırılan trophy listelerinden elde edildi ve Activision tarafından resmi olarak onaylanana kadar spekülatif kalacak.

es.title: Filtra la información sobre Black Ops 1 y 2 en PS5: ¿Qué modos favoritos de los fanáticos podrían faltar?
es.summary: Las listas de trofeos filtradas de los rumoreados remasters de Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 y 2 han generado preocupación entre los fanáticos, ya que parecen omitir modos como Theater Mode y Wager Matches. La ausencia de estos modos podría afectar la experiencia de juego y la autenticidad de los remasters.
es.body:
Los rumores sobre Call of Duty están en marcha nuevamente, esta vez con murmullos sobre el regreso de **Black Ops 1** y **Black Ops 2** en consolas de última generación. Las filtraciones recientes de listas de trofeos de PlayStation para ambos títulos han generado emoción, pero también inquietud entre los fanáticos de larga data. Aunque muchos trofeos reflejan a sus contrapartes originales de PS3, la ausencia de varios otros sugiere una experiencia potencialmente recortada.

En particular, los trofeos relacionados con **Theater Mode**, **League Play** y **Wager Matches** parecen estar ausentes en las listas que han surgido. Para aquellos que recuerdan los días de gloria de **Black Ops**, Theater Mode era una herramienta invaluable para los creadores de contenido, permitiendo a los jugadores capturar y editar metraje de juego. Wager Matches ofrecían un giro único y de alto riesgo en el multiplayer, introduciendo modos favoritos de los fanáticos como Gun Game y One in the Chamber, donde los jugadores apostaban moneda en el juego por la oportunidad de victoria. La eliminación de trofeos vinculados a estas características sugiere fuertemente que podrían no estar incluidos en las versiones reeditadas, una perspectiva que ha dejado a muchos jugadores desanimados.

## ¿Qué está faltando y por qué importa

La eliminación de estos modos específicos no se trata solo de nostalgia; afecta la esencia misma de lo que hizo que **Black Ops 1** y **Black Ops 2** fueran tan populares y duraderos. Theater Mode fue crucial para el crecimiento temprano de la comunidad de YouTube de Call of Duty, permitiendo a una generación de jugadores compartir sus mejores momentos. Wager Matches, con su riesgo y recompensa inherentes, agregaron una capa emocionante de imprevisibilidad al juego. Aunque la omisión de League Play podría ser más comprensible dado la dificultad de replicar una escena competitiva robusta años después, la posible pérdida de modos como Gun Game y One in the Chamber – incluso sin el elemento de apuesta – es un golpe significativo para la reproducibilidad de los juegos.

Los fanáticos han tomado las redes sociales y foros para expresar su frustración. El consenso es claro: aunque un remaster es bienvenido, quitar características queridas disminuye la autenticidad de la experiencia. La esperanza es que estos modos aún puedan estar incluidos, tal vez sin trofeos asociados, o que Activision reconsiderará su inclusión antes de un lanzamiento final. Los desarrolladores tienen un delicado equilibrio, apuntando a modernizar clásicos mientras respetan su atractivo original.

## Próximos Pasos

Los detalles sobre una fecha de lanzamiento oficial o confirmación de estos remasters aún no han sido anunciados. Los jugadores deberán mantener un ojo cercano en los canales oficiales de Call of Duty y en fuentes de noticias de juegos confiables para obtener más actualizaciones. La información actual, derivada de listas de trofeos filtradas, remains especulativa hasta que sea confirmada oficialmente por Activision.

content_raw: Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 and 2 might be missing a few modes and pieces of content when they're re-released for PS4 and PS5 later this month. The trophy lists for both games have appeared online and, while they're largely identical to the original PS3 versions, there are a few differences. As pointed out by X user ForwardLeaks , several trophies around using the game's theater mode, League Play, and winning wager matches have been outright removed. Theater mode allowed players to watch replays of previous matches and move the camera around, which was useful for content creation during YouTube's infancy. Wager matches, on the other hand, were a playlist that allowed players to gamble in-game currency on more unique game modes. These modes included Gun Game, a mode where you change guns everytime you get a kill, and One in the Chamber, where you only have one bullet and can only get more by killing other players. These modes were a ton of fun and have found their way into other Call of Duty games without the gambling component. However, with the trophies for these features and modes missing, it seems likely that they won't be part of the re-released games at all. Additionally, a trophy tied to Black Ops 2's League Play was also removed. That one is a bit less surprising, since it seems hard to imagine these ports having an active, long-term competitive scene all these years later. It's possible some of these features do still exist and the trophies were only removed, but given that the bulk of trophies remain unchanged, it's more likely these modes will be excluded. Maybe if we're lucky, game types like One in the Chamber and Gun Game will still be in the game, minus the gambling. Various governments have implemented regulations when it comes to having any kind of gambling in video games since the release of Black Ops in 2010, so Activision may have chosen to avoid the mechanism altogether this time. As of right now, Activision has yet to confirm the exact release date for these re-releases, but we do know both Black Ops games will be dropping on modern PlayStation consoles sometime in July . Activision has also confirmed that both games will include the campaign, multiplayer, and Zombies modes. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team.
